) ,rate as( SELECT BASIS_CYY ccyOriginal, QUOT_CYY ccyConvert, TRADE_DATE publishDate, case when #{rateflag,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '02' then CLOSE_PRICE/(case when info.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else info.QUOT_UNIT end) when #{rateflag,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '01' then OPEN_PRICE/(case when info.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else info.QUOT_UNIT end) when #{rateflag,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '03' then HIGH_PRICE/(case when info.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else info.QUOT_UNIT end) when #{rateflag,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '04' then LOW_PRICE/(case when info.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else info.QUOT_UNIT end) when #{rateflag,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '05' then MID_PRICE/(case when info.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else info.QUOT_UNIT end) end yeid FROM MST_EXCHARGE_QUOTE info where info.QUOT_CYY = 'CNY' and info.DATASOURCE_TYPE='SAFE' and info.TRADE_DATE = (select max(t.TRADE_DATE) from MST_EXCHARGE_QUOTE t where t.BASIS_CYY = info.BASIS_CYY and t.QUOT_CYY = info.QUOT_CYY and t.DATASOURCE_TYPE='SAFE' and t.TRADE_DATE <=to_date(#{dealdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyyMMdd')) ) , ds as( select sum(nvl(OIC_PORT,0)+nvl(HNWC_PORT,0)+nvl(PBC_PORT,0)) pr, sum(nvl(NFCC_PORT,0)+nvl(AMPRO_PORT,0)+nvl(OTHER_PORT,0)) fjr, sum(nvl(BAN_INS_PORT,0)) ba, sum(nvl(OFIC_PORT,0)) ot, dd.prod_id from P_INTERF_SALE_GDATA_DETAIL dd left join chb_prd_baseinfo cb on DD.prod_id=CB.PROD_ID and CB.STATUS !='D'
where cb.PROFIT_TYPE='03' and GDATE=to_date(#{dealdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyyMMdd') group by dd.prod_id)
